svg.title: Per-Request Authorization Chain
svg.desc: A sequence diagram generated by Archify.

g.text: HTTP actual-request protection or WebSocket origin check
Missing required schema headers returns 401 before command decode
Once per HTTP request; once per WebSocket session
WebSocket invokes this for every message
Parser-backed checks run before cache lookup
The pool reuses connections; a new physical connection runs the connector callback and initializer
